definitions.name: S0C.NEWRUN
definitions.body: 'XS' BIND XS 0 GET 1 SUB 1 COLLECT XS -1 DROP CONCAT 'PV' BIND XS PV LT NOT XS PV GT NOT AND NOT
definitions.note: Truth vector: TRUE at each position whose value differs from the previous one (position 0 always TRUE).

definitions.name: S0C.STARTS
definitions.body: 'STB' BIND STB LENGTH 'STN' BIND STB 0 STN 1 SUB RANGE GROUP TRUE GET
definitions.note: Indices of the TRUE lanes of a truth vector, ascending (requires a TRUE lane).

definitions.name: S0C.SEGLENS
definitions.body: 'BQ' BIND BQ S0C.STARTS 'SQ' BIND SQ BQ LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT 'EQN' BIND EQN 1 DROP EQN -1 DROP SUB
definitions.note: Given a truth vector that starts a segment at each TRUE, the length of each segment.

definitions.name: S0C.RLE
definitions.body: 'XR' BIND XR S0C.NEWRUN 'NQ' BIND NQ S0C.STARTS 'ST' BIND XR ST GET 'VL' BIND VL NQ S0C.SEGLENS 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Run-length encoding: Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run.

definitions.name: S0C.DEDUPE
definitions.body: 'XD' BIND XD S0C.NEWRUN S0C.STARTS 'SD' BIND XD SD GET
definitions.note: Vector with each run of equal adjacent values collapsed to one value.

definitions.name: S0C.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'XU' BIND XU 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT XU -1 DROP CONCAT 'PU' BIND XU PU GT NOT S0C.SEGLENS 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Length of the longest strictly increasing stretch (a break is every position not greater than its predecessor; segment lengths, then max).

definitions.name: S0C.MAJ
definitions.body: 'XM' BIND XM TALLY 'TM' BIND XM LENGTH 'NM' BIND TM KEYS TM VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 2 MUL NM GT ] FILTER FLATTEN 0 GET
definitions.note: Value occurring in more than half the positions (TALLY counts, keep 2*count > length), or NIL.

definitions.name: S0C.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'NP' BIND 1 NP RANGE 'DV' BIND 2 NP RANGE [ DV DIV RATIO ZIP 1 GET 1 GT NOT [ TRUE AND ] FILTER LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Primes from 2 to the number: keep m when exactly two of 1..N divide it (den of m/d equals 1).

definitions.name: S0C.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'NX' BIND 1 NX RANGE 'DV' BIND NX DV DIV RATIO ZIP 1 GET 1 GT NOT S0C.STARTS 'SX' BIND DV SX GET
definitions.note: Ascending positive divisors of the number: d in 1..N with N/d an integer.

definitions.name: S0C.BINARY
definitions.body: 'NB' BIND 0 6 RANGE 'KA' BIND 2 KA POW 'PA' BIND PA NB GT NOT S0C.STARTS 'KV' BIND 2 KV POW 'PK' BIND NB PK DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB REVERSE STR JOIN
definitions.note: Binary text of N: bits floor(N/2^k) mod 2 for every k with 2^k <= N, most significant first.

definitions.name: S0C.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'SP' BIND SP 0 GET 'CX' BIND SP 1 GET 'CC' BIND CX 1 EQ 'DN' BIND 1 CX 2 DIV CX 3 MUL 1 ADD CX 2 DIV RATIO 1 GET 1 EQ SELECT DN SELECT 0 1 DN SELECT CC ADD 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: One Collatz step on the pair [ value steps ]; stays at 1 and stops counting once it reaches 1.

definitions.name: S0C.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'NZ' BIND 0 199 RANGE NZ 0 2 COLLECT [ 0 MUL ADD S0C.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: Collatz step count to reach 1, by 200 fixed FOLD steps (enough for every input 1 to 60).

definitions.name: S0C.FIBSTEP
definitions.body: 'FP' BIND FP 1 GET FP 0 GET FP 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: Fibonacci pair step: [ a b ] to [ b a+b ].

definitions.name: S0C.FIBIDX
definitions.body: 'NF' BIND 0 11 RANGE 0 1 2 COLLECT [ 0 MUL ADD S0C.FIBSTEP ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP 'FL' BIND FL NF LT [ TRUE AND ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: Smallest k with F(k) >= N: one more than the count of Fibonacci numbers F(1..12) below N.

definitions.name: S0C.DSUM
definitions.body: STR CHARS [ NUM ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: One pass of decimal digit sum (apply three times for a digital root of any input up to 999).

definitions.name: S0C.ENC
definitions.body: 'CH' BIND '([)]' CH SEARCH
definitions.note: Bracket character to code: ( 0, [ 1, ) 2, ] 3.

definitions.name: S0C.RSTEP
definitions.body: 'CE' BIND 'AS' BIND AS -1 DROP AS CE 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 CE AS -1 GET SUB 2 EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: Stack reduction step for matched pairs: pop the top if it is the matching open bracket, else push. Stack starts as [ 9 ] (sentinel).

definitions.name: S0C.DEP
definitions.body: 'CE' BIND 'AC' BIND AC 1 ADD AC 1 SUB 0 MAX CE 2 LT SELECT
definitions.note: Open-bracket counter step: +1 on an open bracket, -1 (floored at 0) on a close bracket.

definitions.name: S0C.CODES
definitions.body: CHARS [ S0C.ENC ] MAP
definitions.note: Bracket String to Vector of codes.

definitions.name: S0C.BRDEPTH
definitions.body: S0C.CODES 0 [ S0C.DEP ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Greatest nesting depth of brackets (either kind).

definitions.name: S0C.BRSTACK
definitions.body: S0C.CODES 9 1 COLLECT [ S0C.RSTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: Reduced bracket stack after deleting matched pairs, with the sentinel 9 at the bottom.

definitions.name: S0C.BALANCED
definitions.body: S0C.BRSTACK LENGTH 1 EQ
definitions.note: TRUE when the reduction leaves nothing but the sentinel.

definitions.name: S0C.UNMATCHED
definitions.body: S0C.BRSTACK LENGTH 1 SUB
definitions.note: Number of characters left after deleting matched pairs.

definitions.name: S0C.BALPREFIX
definitions.body: S0C.CODES 'EV' BIND EV 9 1 COLLECT [ S0C.RSTEP ] SCAN [ LENGTH ] MAP 1 GT NOT 'TB' BIND EV 0 [ 0 MUL ADD 1 ADD ] SCAN 'IX' BIND IX 0 TB SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Length of the longest balanced prefix: largest 1-based position whose prefix reduces to nothing, else 0.
